neighbours.label: The letters 'voc' at a word start: ' VOC', ' voc', ' Voc', V|oc, ' vocal' (VOC, vocational, vocal, vociferous)
fire: Ships of the VOC sailed from Amsterdam to Batavia every spring.
New rules limit the VOC content of paints sold in the state.
The lead singer strained her vocal cords during the long tour.
After the merger the VOC controlled most of the nutmeg trade.
The choir teacher praised his vocal control in the final song.
Printers and glues can emit VOC fumes in a closed office.
Critics of the plan were vocal at every meeting of the council.
A warehouse of the VOC still stands beside the old harbour.
quiet: Ships of the navy sailed from Amsterdam to Batavia every spring.
New rules limit the lead content of paints sold in the state.
The lead singer strained her voice badly during the long tour.
After the merger the firm controlled most of the nutmeg trade.
The choir teacher praised his breath control in the final song.
Printers and glues can emit toxic fumes in a closed office.
Critics of the plan were loud at every meeting of the council.
A warehouse of the guild still stands beside the old harbour.

notes: Card: 'OC' after V, ' voc', 'oc', ' Voc', 'ocal', ' VOC'. Probes: ' VOC' 0.83 and 0.72, ' vocal' 0.51, ' vocational' 0.21; voice / vacuum 0.00, local / focal / social 0.05, advocate / avocado / provoke 0.02, so it needs the word-start 'voc', not 'oc' or 'vo' alone. The - pole is the pieces 'ower' / 'bic' / 'obar'.
